test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Pocket an insult
solution:
The correct answer is "**tolerate insult without protest**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate answer which means "**pocket an insult**" is "**tolerate insult without protest**".
 
• "**Pocket an insult**" means **withstanding an insult without retreating back**. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Tom **pocketed John's insults** because they were friends. * 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
